scope: All126source-linked foundation/door candidates and native source building bounds are measured. Unselected blocked candidate counts are retained; at least one physical entry per source building is required. Two street scenario starts are explicit test teleports. Subsequent lobby walks, fresh physical E, actual floor-picker buttons, full phased cabin rides, roof E without another pose, and walkout use production controllers. Screenshots are actual native viewport pixels only when rendered. No survey, real access, full external street journey, human usability, M4 or export claim.
